object: Novel by Benjamín Labatut (2023).  Traces the arc from Paul Ehrenfest's anguish at the Solvay debates through John von Neumann's creation of the modern computer to AlphaGo's Move 37.  The book that connects the endpoints of the deterministic shockwave.
